항목.프롬프트: Caleb, a strong Israelite warrior of about thirty with a short dark brown beard and dark hair, a bright brave face, wearing a green-and-tan wool tunic with a brown leather belt, leather bracers and a cream headcloth with a cord, holding a wooden hunting bow in one hand, a quiver of arrows on his back, energetic confident stance, exactly two arms and exactly two legs, both feet in leather boots.

Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game, one single full-bleed scene with no border and no frame: at sunset on the plateau of Bashan the huge giant king Og, a giant with a long black beard, an iron crown and dark iron scale armor with a black-and-crimson cloak has dropped his iron mace and kneels on one knee with a calm face, while the dark shadow creature that held him by strings breaks apart and flees into the sky; in front of him stands Caleb, a strong Israelite warrior of about thirty with a short dark brown beard and dark hair, a bright brave face, wearing a green-and-tan wool tunic with a brown leather belt, leather bracers and a cream headcloth, holding a bow, with a few Israelite men behind him, all safe; warm golden light pours from the sky; no blood, nobody lying on the ground. Every person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet.
